thread.title: Apple unveils iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple unveils iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.65% on Wednesday announced the 5.8-inch iPhone XS and the 6.5-inch iPhone XS Max at its launch event in Cupertino, Calif. The phones have an A12 chip that Apple said is the industry's first 7-nanometer chip. The two new devices have edge-to-edge OLED screens. There will be a 512GB storage option and the phone will come in a gold color variation. Apple shares are down 0.7% in Wednesday's session, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.04% is little changed.
